text:
nina (People Ops): Quick flag — Luca converted from contractor -> employee effective 2026-02-15. Payroll ingestion shows both the Italy contractor payment and Dutch payroll applied employee social contributions for Jan. Need reconciliation and an off-cycle correction. @oliver can you confirm what you see?

oliver (Payroll): Yep saw duplicate employee social on the payslip. Contractor invoice was processed in Italy and the NL payroll also applied employee social. If Italy paid INPS, options: reclaim from INPS or gross-up the employee and adjust at year-end. Reclaim takes 6-8 weeks usually. For speed we can do an off-cycle net credit in March and mark for reversal when reclaim comes in. Need invoice PDF, bank remittance, and contractor TIN.

eva (Finance Ops): We can do an off-cycle once docs and JE are in place. Send invoice + remittance to finance-payroll@redwood.com and CC me. I'll prepare JE template. Confirm Luca's official payroll start date (should match HR: 2026-02-15).

luca (Employee): I uploaded the invoice + payment receipt to my HR folder (onboard/luca/contractor-payments). Contractor TIN: IT-12345678. NL BSN provided during onboarding. I can re-upload here if easier.

oliver (Payroll): Pulling the files now. If the payment in Italy recorded employee social (INPS), reclaim is the right path. For interim we will tag the off-cycle: code OFFCYCLE_CORR | GL 6100 | DEBIT EMP_SOC. Will need JE id from Finance and manager sign-off.

nina (People Ops): Approved to proceed with off-cycle pending docs. I've pinged Luca's manager for sign-off. @marta please advise on cross-border social security documentation we need for reclaim.

marta (Legal): We'll need: 1) signed contractor declaration confirming contributions paid in Italy, 2) original invoice + bank remittance showing country of payment, 3) timeline evidence showing NL employment start date after the Italy payment. With that Legal will draft reclaim support letter and coordinate with Tax counsel re: A1 certificate or bilateral agreements.

eva (Finance Ops): JE requested — will create JE-2026-045 referencing "Off-cycle social contrib correction - Luca". Once JE exists I will upload to finance drive and notify payroll-bot.

payroll-bot: Payrun 2026-03-offcycle queued — job id 24567. Awaiting JE and doc attachments. Link: https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/24567 :clipboard:

oliver (Payroll): I'll attach docs and schedule the off-cycle as soon as JE + signed declaration are in drive. I'll mark the payrun with tag retro-social-reclaim and include comment for year-end reconciliation.

luca (Employee): Thanks all — re-uploading signed declaration now and pinged my manager for the sign-off. Appreciate the quick help! :pray:
